name: mirage
text: No, not by the engine's last check (~2 min ago): BoltOdds' key is Active and accepted (78 sports, 37 books). BoltOdds publishes no usage or expiry figure, so I can't see a trial end date. Its props socket is live; the lines socket is not live right now (that is a socket fault, not the key, and the API manager is watching it). If a trial end is coming, you'd see the key flip to refused.
